name: bone-soldier
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game animation sprite sheet, 2048x2048, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 isolated full-body complete connected character cels. Rich realistic 1980s oil-painted sword-and-sorcery game art with crisply modeled bronze armor, textured fabric, anatomical readable silhouette like classic painted barbarian sprites. Flat uniform chroma green #10f00f background, no shadows, no grid lines, no text. Each cell same scale and consistent head size and body proportions. Every cel faces RIGHT side three-quarter (including combat). Keep every figure within its cell with generous margins; standing feet at cell y=.90, standing head top y=.12. Do not draw ANY weapons or shields or handles in body cels. Right hand is a closed gripping fist for later weapon attachment; empty left fist. Fullbody poses rowmajor indices: 0 idle guard; 1 walk left foot forward; 2 walk passing; 3 walk right foot forward; 4 walk opposite passing; 5 attack windup right fist pulled back at shoulder; 6 committed attack/lunge right fist extended forward; 7 low follow-through recovery fist low forward; 8 high overhead windup fist above head; 9 overhead hit fist thrust down forward; 10 low recovery crouch fist low; 11 hurt recoil torso thrown back; 12 falling sideways knees collapsing; 13 whole body on ground; 14 rising from one knee; 15 braced guard/shoulder-check windup. Each attack must show meaningful torso, hip, knee and arm pose changes, not only arms. No detached legs. Bone Soldier: tall lean exposed ivory skeleton, incomplete battered bronze cuirass, dark padded tunic, open bronze helmet with NO horns, ONE armored shoulder, torn crimson strip. Exposed skeletal face and thin bony limbs. No cloak.
